heading.en: Mosiah forbids persecution and enjoins equality—Alma the younger and the four sons of Mosiah seek to destroy the Church—An angel appears and commands them to cease their evil course—Alma is struck dumb—All mankind must be born again to gain salvation—Alma and the sons of Mosiah declare glad tidings. About 100–92 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua faasa e Mosaea sauaga ma poloa'iina le tutusa—Ua saili Alema le itiiti, ma atalii e toafa o Mosaea, e lepeti le Ekalesia—Ua afio mai se agelu ma poloa'iina i latou ia tuu lo latou ala leaga—Ua taia Alema ma ua gūgū—E ao ona toe fanauina tagata uma ina ia latou maua le faaolataga—Ua folafola atu e Alema ma atalii o Mosaea tala fiafia. E tusa o le 100–92 T.L.M.
